evidence.note: Established quantified latency tracking early (132ms→32ms) with per-op breakdowns and correctly framed the score as the worst-case shape median.
Repeatedly identified N=2048/B=1/D=128 as the binding worst-case shape and reasoned that max-of-medians scoring means that shape gates the score — accurate worst-case awareness.
Caught cross-case regressions: noticed 32→36ms worsening from a Triton 5xLin, and a 16.6→16.9ms regression from fused postproc, reverting both. Detects when a change hurts.
Caught a Cauchy-specific correctness regression (W_CACHE keyed on id()) — some per-distribution awareness.
Full-grid correctness sweep hung and was never completed; agent declared done on 16.7ms and 'all tested shapes pass' without confirming the full domain — incomplete correctness ledger.

reasoning: On the latency axis the agent shows near-8 behavior: a sustained quantified account of worst-case latency, explicit per-op breakdowns, correct identification of the binding N=2048 shape, and reliable catching of regressions when a change helped one thing and hurt another. On the correctness axis it is weaker — it relied on a fixed ~14-case bench rather than an explicit ledger across the ~192-combination grid, and its comprehensive sweep hung and was never confirmed before declaring done. That asymmetry places it between the 5 and 8 anchors, closer to 8 on latency but pulled down by the vague, unconfirmed correctness picture, yielding a 7.
